message.shulkerpickblock.swapped_into_bo: Stored %s in the shulker box to make room
message.shulkerpickblock.hand_full: No room to pick %s — your held shulker box can't be stored
text.shulkerpickblock.config.title: PA9 Shulker Pick Block
text.shulkerpickblock.config.hint: Saved to config/shulkerpickblock.toml when you press Done.
text.shulkerpickblock.config.reset.toolt: Restores every option above to its default. Press Done to keep it.
text.shulkerpickblock.config.enabled.too: Master toggle. When off, pick block behaves exactly like vanilla.
text.shulkerpickblock.config.scan_offhan: Also search a shulker box held in your off-hand, not just the main inventory.
text.shulkerpickblock.config.source_sele: Which matching stack to pull when several carried boxes hold the item.
Take from the biggest matching stack. Keeps stacks whole and leaves partial stacks alone.
Take from the smallest matching stack. Uses up leftovers first and consolidates boxes over time.
Take the first match in slot order (inventory slots, then off-hand). Fully predictable.
text.shulkerpickblock.config.hotbar_slot: Which hotbar slot receives the extracted item.
The slot vanilla pick block would use: an empty hotbar slot if there is one, otherwise the selected slot.
Always the hotbar slot you have selected.
The hotbar slot you have gone the longest without holding.
text.shulkerpickblock.config.show_hud_me: Show a brief on-screen note when an item is pulled out of a shulker box.
text.shulkerpickblock.config.hud_message: How long the HUD notification stays on screen. 20 ticks = 1 second.
text.shulkerpickblock.config.litematica_: Supply blocks from your shulker boxes to Litematica's Easy Place. Ignored if Litematica isn't installed.
text.shulkerpickblock.config.debug_loggi: Write verbose scan diagnostics to the game log. Development use only.
